clue.text: Item of furniture made by versatile cook in military centre

indicators.note: in says the shuffled letters go inside the word for the military centre

parts.note: a base is the headquarters or centre of military operations

indicators.note: versatile suggests something that can take many forms, so these letters are reshaped

explanation.surface: A piece of furniture produced by an all-round army cook at the barracks.
explanation.definitionFit: A set of shelves for books is a familiar piece of household furniture.

clue.text: Enthusiasts returned in shock

indicators.note: returned means the word for enthusiasts is sent back the other way

parts.note: nuts are fans or enthusiasts, as in 'football nuts'

explanation.surface: Fans coming home in a state of shock.
explanation.definitionFit: To daze or stagger someone is to shock them; the verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Motive, originally, behind very short note

indicators.note: behind says the motive's first letter comes after the word for very short

parts.note: mini means very small or short, as in a miniskirt

indicators.note: originally points to the opening letter of the word motive

explanation.surface: A musician's motive placed behind a very brief note.
explanation.walkthrough: A motive is also a musical motif, which helps the musical disguise; 'originally' gives M.
explanation.definitionFit: In music a minim is a note lasting half a semibreve, called a half note in America.

clue.text: Smoke in church to cause great anger

definitions.meaning: the fragrant smoke from burning resin swung in a censer during a church service
a verb meaning to enrage or make furious

explanation.surface: Fumes in church can make people furious.
explanation.definitionFit: The noun is aromatic smoke used in worship; the verb, stressed on the second syllable, means to enrage.

clue.text: Anger shown when leader leaves Ireland

indicators.note: the leader is the first letter of the word, which departs

parts.note: Eire is the Irish-language name of Ireland

explanation.surface: Anger displayed as someone in charge quits Ireland.
explanation.walkthrough: Ireland must first be turned into EIRE before its leading E goes.
explanation.definitionFit: Ire is a literary synonym for wrath or fury.

clue.text: No doubt about female not going in the right direction

definitions.text: not going in the right direction

indicators.note: about means the phrase for no doubt goes around the letter for female

parts.note: 'of course' is a phrase meaning certainly, without doubt

explanation.surface: Certainly a woman is heading the wrong way.
explanation.walkthrough: The F goes in beside the existing F, giving OFF.
explanation.definitionFit: A ship or aircraft that has strayed from its intended route is said to be astray in this way.

clue.text: Fruit — round variety

parts.note: O is round in shape
a range is a variety or assortment, as in a range of goods

explanation.surface: A spherical type of fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: A citrus fruit, the commonest example of the category.

clue.text: Way of serving meat, some beef, lamb, etc.

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A cooking method applied to beef, lamb and similar meats.
explanation.definitionFit: Food served doused in spirit and set alight is a dramatic restaurant style of presentation.

clue.text: Incomplete instrument — girl provides another

indicators.note: incomplete means the instrument's word is cut short by its final letter

parts.note: a harp is a stringed musical instrument
Monica is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl supplies a second instrument when the first is unfinished.
explanation.walkthrough: 'another' is the definition: another instrument, following the one in the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A mouth organ is a further musical instrument, so 'another' stands for it after the harp.

clue.text: Reportedly purchase extra

indicators.note: reportedly signals that what is wanted is how the word for purchase is said

parts.note: to buy is to purchase

explanation.surface: Allegedly something bought costs more.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, a bye is a run scored without the batsman hitting the ball, counted among the extras.
explanation.definitionFit: A bye is one of the cricket extras, runs added to the score not off the bat.

clue.text: Income from flat in Parisian street

indicators.note: in puts the word for flat inside the French street

parts.note: rue is the French word for street
even means flat or level

explanation.surface: Earnings from an apartment on a Paris street.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flat' looks like an apartment but means level.
explanation.definitionFit: Revenue is the money an organisation or state takes in, a synonym for its earnings.

clue.text: Food in centre of canteen, ready to eat

indicators.note: the centre of a seven-letter word is its fourth letter

parts.note: ripe fruit is ready to be eaten

explanation.surface: Something served in a canteen, prepared for eating.
explanation.walkthrough: Tripe is the stomach lining of cattle, eaten in Britain, notably the north of England.
explanation.definitionFit: Tripe is an offal dish, cow's stomach lining, so it counts as a type of food.

clue.text: Support husband, advanced in years

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for husband in genealogy
old means elderly, advanced in years

explanation.surface: Backing an elderly spouse.
explanation.definitionFit: To bear or hold up something is to support it, so the verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Nothing left in safe

definitions.meaning: if everything is on the right side, there is nothing on the left: a cryptic reading

explanation.surface: Nothing remaining in a strongbox.
explanation.walkthrough: 'safe' looks like the strongbox but is the adjective meaning unharmed.
explanation.definitionFit: Taken literally the phrase says every part is to the right; in everyday use it means unharmed or fine.

clue.text: Graduate doctor at home with love child

parts.note: a BA, Bachelor of Arts, is a graduate
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's degree
in means at home
love is zero in tennis, which looks like O

explanation.surface: A graduate doctor at home with a love child.
explanation.definitionFit: Bambino is Italian for a baby or small child, used informally in English.

clue.text: Small amount of uranium brought in long ago

indicators.note: brought in means the uranium symbol is placed inside the phrase for long ago

parts.note: once means at some time in the past
U is the chemical symbol for uranium

explanation.surface: A little uranium was imported years ago.
explanation.definitionFit: An ounce is a small unit of weight, so figuratively a tiny quantity, as in 'not an ounce of sense'.

clue.text: Shared views in familiar stadium

parts.note: common means ordinary or familiar
a ground is a sports stadium, as in a football ground

explanation.surface: Fans in a well-known stadium sharing opinions.
explanation.definitionFit: Opinions or interests held by both sides of a debate are what they agree on.

clue.text: Difficult son spat

parts.note: a spat is a petty quarrel, a tiff

explanation.surface: A troublesome son had a squabble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spat' looks like a verb but is the noun for a squabble.
explanation.definitionFit: A stiff test or task is a hard one, so the adjectives are synonyms.

clue.text: Time after time, an odd childish fit of rage

indicators.note: after says the first time comes after the second time and the word an

parts.note: rum is a dated British word for odd or strange

explanation.surface: Again and again, a strange infantile outburst.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Time after time' looks like an idiom for repeatedly, but builds T, AN, T in that order.
explanation.definitionFit: A tantrum is an uncontrolled outburst of temper, typically from a small child.

clue.text: Relative, kind to conserve energy

indicators.note: to conserve means to keep within, so the word for kind holds the energy symbol

parts.note: nice means kind or pleasant
E is the symbol for energy in physics

explanation.surface: A family member kindly saving energy.
explanation.definitionFit: A brother's or sister's daughter is a family member, a relative.

clue.text: Too charmless, possibly, for a teacher

indicators.note: possibly says the letters could form something else when rearranged

explanation.surface: A teacher who is perhaps lacking in charm.
explanation.definitionFit: A male teacher in a school, an old-fashioned word for the job.

clue.text: Newcomer, a challenger crossing river

indicators.note: crossing means the letters straddle the river abbreviation, holding it within

parts.note: a rival is a competitor or challenger

explanation.surface: A new arrival, a contender wading across a river.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who has just come is a fresh face, a newcomer.

clue.text: Most serious, heading off for high peak

indicators.note: heading off means the first letter of the word is removed

parts.note: severest means most serious or grave

explanation.surface: The gravest problem is setting off for a lofty summit.
explanation.definitionFit: Everest in the Himalayas is the world's highest mountain peak.

clue.text: Grating last of Cheddar into mince

indicators.note: into says the final letter goes inside the word for mince

parts.note: hash is a dish of chopped or minced meat

indicators.note: last of points to the final letter of the cheese's name

explanation.surface: Grating Cheddar into minced meat for a dish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Grating' looks like a kitchen verb but is an adjective meaning rasping.
explanation.definitionFit: A grating noise is harsh, rough and unpleasant to hear.

clue.text: Perfect plan over lake

indicators.note: over in a down clue places the plan's word above the lake's letter

parts.note: an idea is a plan or scheme
L is the abbreviation for lake on maps

explanation.surface: An excellent scheme involving a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: An ideal solution is a flawless one, so the adjectives are synonyms.

clue.text: Fetch bishop token of his authority

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
a bishop wears a ring as a sign of his office

explanation.surface: Bring the bishop his ring of office.
explanation.definitionFit: To fetch something is to go and bring it back, so the verbs are synonyms.
